name: mindsai-personas
description: Build AI knowledge bases, run multi-perspective research panels, and export branded reports. Train AI on topics, documents, or websites. Survey synthetic expert groups for market research and policy testing.
author: Minds AI

tools.name: list_minds
tools.description: List your Minds (also called: AI personas, experts, digital twins, consumers, respondents, characters, profiles). Supports fuzzy name search.

tools.name: create_mind
tools.description: Create a Mind — an AI persona / expert / digital twin / consumer character — trained on topics (keywords mode), a public figure (clone mode), or a URL (link mode).

tools.name: chat_with_mind
tools.description: Talk / message / chat with one of your Minds. Use this for 1:1 conversations — to survey multiple Minds at once, use ask_panel.

tools.name: get_mind_status
tools.description: Check whether a Mind has finished training. Returns the current training stage and progress percentage.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List your groups (also called: segments, audiences, cohorts) with their member Minds.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a named group of Minds (a segment / audience / cohort) to use as a building block for panels.

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: List your panels (also called: studies, surveys, research projects, focus groups, qual studies, conversations). Supports fuzzy name search.

tools.name: create_panel
tools.description: Start a research panel / study / survey / focus group with one or more groups of Minds for comparative analysis.

tools.name: ask_panel
tools.description: Ask / survey / poll a panel any question. Each Mind answers; results aggregate per group (mean, dominant choice, theme clusters). Triggers: 'how do they feel', 'what does <panel> think', 'ask the group'.

tools.name: get_panel_status
tools.description: Get a panel's live status — groups, members, in-flight questions, completed results (with per-group breakdowns), and PDF export status.

tools.name: get_panel_analytics
tools.description: Summarize a panel's findings across all questions — mean, distribution, theme clusters, group divergence, scale-question ranking.

tools.name: export_panel
tools.description: Export / download a panel as branded PDF, Markdown, CSV, Excel, or JSON. PDF is the default polished report; Markdown ('md') is best for inline display in chat.

resources.name: ai-persona-widget
resources.description: Interactive widget for creating and chatting with Minds
